hero.title: A clear path from idea to final collection.
hero.description: See what happens at every stage, who owns the next action and which details must be confirmed before your event moves forward.

flow.title: Know what happens next
phases: Browse products, packages, availability and planning guidance.
Confirm your date, venue, guest count, access and service requirements.
Receive an itemised quotation with products, logistics, GST and terms.
Approve the current quote and pay the required deposit securely.
Follow warehouse checks, delivery timing and venue access updates.
Receive, use and care for the hired equipment as confirmed.
Complete collection, condition review, final documents and rewards.

checkpoints.title: Nothing important is assumed.
checkpoints.description: Stock, price, delivery, setup and payment remain visible and require confirmation at the correct stage.

cta.title: Ready for stage one?
cta.description: Start with products, a package or a conversation with the planning team.
